senses.gloss: प्लिह r. 1st cl. (प्लेहति) To go, to move or approach.
प्लिहा f. (-हा) The spleen: see प्लीहन् ।
प्लिहन् m. (-हा) The spleen: see प्लीहन् ।

प्लीहन् m. (-हा) The spleen; the organ or the disease of it, as in Eng-
lish; in the latter sense, however, it is equally applied to the
enlargement of the mesenteric glands, &c.
 E. प्लिह् to increase,
Unādi aff. कनिन्, and the vowel made long; otherwise being
प्लिहन्; and with क and टाप् affs., and the vowel long or short प्लिहा
or प्लीहा ।

प्लीहघ्न m. (-घ्नः) A medicinal plant, (Andersonia rohitaka, Rox.)
 E. प्लीह
the spleen, (the disease, &c.) घ्न what removes.

प्लीहशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) A medical plant, commonly Rohera or Rohinī, (An-
dersonia rohitaka, Rox.)
 E. प्लीह for प्लोहन् the spleen, (the disease,)
and शत्रु enemy; also प्लीहाशत्रु ।

प्लीहारि m. (-रिः) The holy fig-tree, (Ficus religiosa,)
 E. प्लीहा the spleen,
and अरि enemy. “अश्वत्थवृक्षे” ।
